WITH RECURSIVE sec AS (SELECT group_id AS sid, group_id AS gid FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id IS NULL)
 UNION ALL SELECT sec.sid, g.group_id FROM dim_merchant_group g JOIN sec ON g.parent_group_id=sec.gid),
tx AS (
 SELECT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc, ta.merchant_id FROM txn t
 JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc>=ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<ta.valid_to)
 WHERE t.ts_utc>='2025-01-01' AND t.ts_utc<'2026-01-01'
),
wk AS (
 SELECT tx.txn_id, sec.sid, tx.ts_utc,
  (CAST(strftime('%j', date(tx.ts_utc, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', tx.ts_utc) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days')) AS INTEGER)-1)/7+1 AS wkno,
  strftime('%Y', date(tx.ts_utc, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', tx.ts_utc) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days')) AS isoy
 FROM tx JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=tx.merchant_id JOIN sec ON sec.gid=m.group_id
),
cnt AS (SELECT sid, wkno AS x, COUNT(DISTINCT txn_id) AS y FROM wk WHERE isoy='2025' GROUP BY sid, wkno)
SELECT g.name, COUNT(*) AS nweeks_with,
 SUM(1)*0 AS dummy
FROM cnt JOIN dim_merchant_group g ON g.group_id=cnt.sid GROUP BY g.name

WITH RECURSIVE sec AS (SELECT group_id AS sid, group_id AS gid FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id IS NULL)
 UNION ALL SELECT sec.sid, g.group_id FROM dim_merchant_group g JOIN sec ON g.parent_group_id=sec.gid),
tx AS (
 SELECT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc, ta.merchant_id FROM txn t
 JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc>=ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<ta.valid_to)
 WHERE t.ts_utc>='2024-12-01' AND t.ts_utc<'2026-01-10'
),
wk AS (
 SELECT tx.txn_id, sec.sid,
  (CAST(strftime('%j', date(tx.ts_utc, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', tx.ts_utc) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days')) AS INTEGER)-1)/7+1 AS wkno,
  strftime('%Y', date(tx.ts_utc, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', tx.ts_utc) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days')) AS isoy
 FROM tx JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=tx.merchant_id JOIN sec ON sec.gid=m.group_id
),
cnt AS (SELECT sid, wkno AS x, COUNT(DISTINCT txn_id) AS y FROM wk WHERE isoy='2025' GROUP BY sid, wkno),
grid AS (SELECT g.sid, n.x FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sid FROM cnt) g CROSS JOIN (WITH RECURSIVE nums(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM nums WHERE x<52) SELECT x FROM nums) n),
full AS (SELECT grid.sid, grid.x, COALESCE(cnt.y,0) AS y FROM grid LEFT JOIN cnt ON cnt.sid=grid.sid AND cnt.x=grid.x)
SELECT g.name,
 ROUND((52*SUM(x*y) - SUM(x)*SUM(y)) * 1.0 / (52*SUM(x*x) - SUM(x)*SUM(x)), 3) AS slope
FROM full JOIN dim_merchant_group g ON g.group_id=full.sid GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY slope DESC

WITH x AS (
 SELECT s.settlement_id, s.settled_at, s.settled_eur_minor AS actual,
   ROUND((t.amount_minor*1.0/POWER(10,c.exponent)) * f.eur_per_unit * 100) AS recomputed
 FROM settlement s JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id=s.txn_id JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=t.currency_id
 LEFT JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id=t.currency_id AND f.rate_date=date(s.settled_at)
),
w AS (SELECT *, date(settled_at, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', settled_at) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days') AS thu FROM x)
SELECT strftime('%Y', thu) || '-W' || printf('%02d', (CAST(strftime('%j', thu) AS INTEGER)-1)/7+1) AS iso, SUM(ABS(actual-recomputed)) AS absdiff, COUNT(*) n, SUM(recomputed IS NULL) AS nulls
FROM w GROUP BY iso ORDER BY absdiff DESC LIMIT 5

WITH RECURSIVE wk(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM wk WHERE x<52),
g2 AS (
  SELECT g.group_id AS g2id, g.name AS gname FROM dim_merchant_group g WHERE g.level=2
),
anc AS (
  SELECT g.group_id AS gid, g.group_id AS aid FROM dim_merchant_group g
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.gid, p.parent_group_id FROM anc a JOIN dim_merchant_group p ON p.group_id=a.aid WHERE p.parent_group_id IS NOT NULL
),
t AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc,
    (CAST(strftime('%j', date(substr(t.ts_utc,1,10), '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', substr(t.ts_utc,1,10)) AS INT)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days')) AS INT)-1)/7+1 AS wk,
    strftime('%Y', date(substr(t.ts_utc,1,10), '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', substr(t.ts_utc,1,10)) AS INT)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days')) AS wy,
    ta.merchant_id
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id
    AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
),
tg AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id, t.wk, a.aid AS g2id
  FROM t JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=t.merchant_id
  JOIN anc a ON a.gid=m.group_id
  JOIN g2 ON g2.g2id=a.aid
  WHERE t.wy='2025'
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT g2id, wk, COUNT(*) c FROM tg GROUP BY g2id, wk
),
grid AS (
  SELECT g2.g2id, wk.x, COALESCE(cnt.c,0) y FROM g2 CROSS JOIN wk LEFT JOIN cnt ON cnt.g2id=g2.g2id AND cnt.wk=wk.x
),
agg AS (
  SELECT g2id, COUNT(*) n, SUM(x) sx, SUM(y) sy, SUM(x*y) sxy, SUM(x*x) sxx FROM grid GROUP BY g2id
)
SELECT g2.gname, (n*sxy - sx*sy)*1.0/(n*sxx - sx*sx) AS slope, sy AS total
FROM agg JOIN g2 ON g2.g2id=agg.g2id ORDER BY slope DESC

WITH t AS (
 SELECT txn_id, ts_utc, terminal_id, response_code, status_id,
  LEAD(ts_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY terminal_id ORDER BY ts_utc, txn_id) AS nxt
 FROM txn
),
rc AS (
 SELECT code, is_timeout FROM response_code_dict WHERE scheme_version=2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_timeouts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN nxt IS NOT NULL AND (julianday(nxt)-julianday(ts_utc))*86400 > 0 AND (julianday(nxt)-julianday(ts_utc))*86400 <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retried,
 COUNT(DISTINCT txn_id) AS d
FROM t JOIN rc ON rc.code = t.response_code AND rc.is_timeout=1
WHERE ts_utc >= '2025-09-18 00:00:00' AND ts_utc < '2025-09-19 00:00:00'

WITH x AS (
SELECT s.settlement_id, s.settled_at, s.settled_eur_minor AS act,
 ROUND(t.amount_minor / CAST(POWER(10, c.exponent) AS REAL) * f.eur_per_unit * 100) AS calc,
 date(s.settled_at) AS d
FROM settlement s JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id=s.txn_id
JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=t.currency_id
LEFT JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id=t.currency_id AND f.rate_date=date(s.settled_at)
), y AS (
SELECT *, ABS(calc-act) AS diff,
 date(settled_at, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w',settled_at) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days') AS thu
FROM x)
SELECT strftime('%Y',thu) || '-W' || printf('%02d', (CAST(strftime('%j',thu) AS INTEGER)-1)/7+1) AS wk,
 SUM(diff) AS total, COUNT(*) n, SUM(calc IS NULL) nulls, SUM(diff>0) nd
FROM y GROUP BY wk ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

WITH x AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc FROM txn t JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id WHERE m.group_id IN (10,11,12,13,14) AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)),
w AS (SELECT txn_id, date(ts_utc, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w',ts_utc) AS INT)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days') AS thu FROM x),
y AS (SELECT thu, CAST(strftime('%Y',thu) AS INT) iy, (CAST(strftime('%j',thu) AS INT)-1)/7+1 iw FROM w)
SELECT iy || '-W' || printf('%02d', iw) wk, COUNT(*) n FROM y GROUP BY iy, iw ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

WITH x AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc FROM txn t JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id WHERE m.group_id IN (10,11,12,13,14)),
w AS (SELECT txn_id, date(ts_utc, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w',ts_utc) AS INT)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days') AS thu FROM x),
y AS (SELECT thu, CAST(strftime('%Y',thu) AS INT) iy, (CAST(strftime('%j',thu) AS INT)-1)/7+1 iw FROM w)
SELECT iy || '-W' || printf('%02d', iw) wk, COUNT(*) n FROM y GROUP BY iy, iw ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

WITH RECURSIVE nums(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM nums WHERE x<52),
t AS (SELECT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc, a.merchant_id FROM txn t JOIN terminal_assignment a ON a.terminal_id=t.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc >= a.valid_from AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < a.valid_to)),
w AS (SELECT txn_id, merchant_id, date(ts_utc, printf('%+d days', 3-((CAST(strftime('%w',ts_utc) AS INTEGER)+6)%7))) AS th FROM t),
w2 AS (SELECT txn_id, merchant_id, (CAST(strftime('%j',th) AS INTEGER)-1)/7+1 AS wk FROM w WHERE strftime('%Y',th)='2025'),
mg AS (SELECT m.merchant_id, CASE WHEN g.level=2 THEN g.group_id ELSE g.parent_group_id END AS div FROM dim_merchant m JOIN dim_merchant_group g ON g.group_id=m.group_id WHERE g.level>=2),
cnt AS (SELECT mg.div, w2.wk, COUNT(*) c FROM w2 JOIN mg ON mg.merchant_id=w2.merchant_id GROUP BY 1,2),
full AS (SELECT d.group_id AS div, n.x AS wk, COALESCE(c.c,0) AS y FROM dim_merchant_group d JOIN nums n LEFT JOIN cnt c ON c.div=d.group_id AND c.wk=n.x WHERE d.level=2),
s AS (SELECT div, COUNT(*) n, SUM(wk) sx, SUM(y) sy, SUM(wk*y) sxy, SUM(wk*wk) sxx, SUM(y*y) syy FROM full GROUP BY div)
SELECT g.name, ROUND((n*sxy - sx*sy)*1.0/(n*sxx - sx*sx),4) AS slope, sy AS total FROM s JOIN dim_merchant_group g ON g.group_id=s.div ORDER BY slope DESC

WITH s AS (
SELECT s.settlement_id, s.settled_at, s.settled_eur_minor AS eur, t.amount_minor, c.exponent, t.currency_id,
 date(s.settled_at) AS d
FROM settlement s JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id=s.txn_id JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=t.currency_id),
x AS (
SELECT s.*, f.eur_per_unit AS r,
 ABS(CAST(ROUND(s.amount_minor/CAST(POWER(10,s.exponent) AS REAL) * f.eur_per_unit * 100) AS INTEGER) - s.eur) AS diff
FROM s JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id=s.currency_id AND f.rate_date=s.d),
w AS (
SELECT x.*, date(d, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w',d) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days') AS thu FROM x)
SELECT strftime('%Y', thu) || '-W' || printf('%02d', (julianday(thu) - julianday(strftime('%Y', thu) || '-01-01'))/7 + 1) AS wk,
 SUM(diff) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(diff>0) AS nd
FROM w GROUP BY wk ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

WITH tl AS (
 SELECT t.txn_id, replace(t.ts_utc,' ','T') ts, t.terminal_id FROM txn t
), a AS (
 SELECT tl.txn_id, tl.ts, l.merchant_id FROM tl JOIN terminal_merchant_link l ON l.terminal_id=tl.terminal_id
 AND tl.ts >= replace(l.start_ts,' ','T') AND (l.end_ts IS NULL OR tl.ts < replace(l.end_ts,' ','T'))
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a) matched, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT txn_id) FROM a) distinct_txn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tl) total FROM tl LIMIT 1

WITH tl AS (
 SELECT t.txn_id, replace(t.ts_utc,' ','T') ts, t.terminal_id FROM txn t
), a AS (
 SELECT tl.txn_id, tl.ts, m.merchant_group_id gid FROM tl JOIN terminal_merchant_link l ON l.terminal_id=tl.terminal_id
 AND tl.ts >= replace(l.start_ts,' ','T') AND (l.end_ts IS NULL OR tl.ts < replace(l.end_ts,' ','T'))
 JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=l.merchant_id
), leaf AS (
 SELECT g.group_id, g.name FROM dim_merchant_group g WHERE g.group_id NOT IN (SELECT parent_group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT leaf.name, a.gid, SUM(CASE WHEN a.ts < '2025-07-01T00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) h1, SUM(CASE WHEN a.ts >= '2025-07-01T00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) h2,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.ts < '2025-07-01T00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) loss
FROM a JOIN leaf ON leaf.group_id=a.gid GROUP BY a.gid ORDER BY loss DESC

SELECT c.change_id, c.component_id, COUNT(e.event_id) AS n
FROM config_change c
LEFT JOIN service_event e
  ON e.component_id = c.component_id
 AND e.level = 'ERROR'
 AND strftime('%s', e.ts_utc) >= strftime('%s', c.changed_at)
 AND strftime('%s', e.ts_utc) < strftime('%s', c.changed_at) + 3600
WHERE c.changed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND c.changed_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.change_id
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH x AS (
SELECT s.settlement_id, s.settled_at, s.settled_eur_minor,
 ABS(ROUND(t.amount_minor * 1.0 / POWER(10, c.exponent) * f.eur_per_unit * 100) - s.settled_eur_minor) AS d,
 date(s.settled_at) AS dd
FROM settlement s JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id=s.txn_id JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=t.currency_id
JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id=t.currency_id AND f.rate_date=date(s.settled_at)
), w AS (
SELECT *, date(dd, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w',dd) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days') AS thu FROM x
)
SELECT strftime('%Y',thu) || '-W' || printf('%02d', (CAST(strftime('%j',thu) AS INTEGER)-1)/7+1) AS wk, SUM(d) AS tot, COUNT(*) n
FROM w GROUP BY wk ORDER BY tot DESC LIMIT 5

WITH leaf AS (SELECT group_id, name FROM dim_merchant_group g WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_merchant_group c WHERE c.parent_group_id=g.group_id)),
t AS (
 SELECT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc, m.merchant_group_id gid FROM txn t
 JOIN terminal_merchant_link l ON l.terminal_id=t.terminal_id AND l.start_ts<=t.ts_utc AND (l.end_ts IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<l.end_ts)
 JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=l.merchant_id
)
SELECT leaf.name,
 SUM(CASE WHEN t.ts_utc<'2025-07-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) h1,
 SUM(CASE WHEN t.ts_utc>='2025-07-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) h2,
 SUM(CASE WHEN t.ts_utc<'2025-07-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) loss
FROM leaf LEFT JOIN t ON t.gid=leaf.group_id
GROUP BY leaf.name ORDER BY loss DESC;

WITH sub AS (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE group_id=10 OR parent_group_id=10 OR parent_group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id=10)),
t_asg AS (
 SELECT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc, strftime('%W', t.ts_utc) AS wk FROM txn t
 JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id
 AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
 JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id
 WHERE m.group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM sub) AND t.ts_utc >= '2025' AND t.ts_utc < '2026'
),
t_grp AS (
 SELECT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc FROM txn t
 JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id
 JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id
 WHERE m.group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM sub) AND t.ts_utc >= '2025' AND t.ts_utc < '2026'
)
SELECT 'asg_time', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT txn_id) FROM t_asg
UNION ALL SELECT 'grp_any', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT txn_id) FROM t_grp;

WITH sub AS (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE group_id=10 OR parent_group_id=10 OR parent_group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id=10)),
t_asg AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc FROM txn t
 JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id
 AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
 JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id
 WHERE m.group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM sub) AND t.ts_utc >= '2025' AND t.ts_utc < '2026'
),
w AS (SELECT txn_id, date(ts_utc, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w',ts_utc) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days') AS thu FROM t_asg)
SELECT strftime('%Y', thu) || '-W' || printf('%02d', (CAST(strftime('%j', thu) AS INTEGER)-1)/7+1) AS iso_wk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM w GROUP BY iso_wk ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

WITH sub AS (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE group_id=10 OR parent_group_id=10 OR parent_group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id=10)),
t_grp AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc FROM txn t
 JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id
 JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id
 WHERE m.group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM sub) AND t.ts_utc >= '2025' AND t.ts_utc < '2026'
),
w AS (SELECT txn_id, date(ts_utc, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w',ts_utc) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days') AS thu FROM t_grp)
SELECT strftime('%Y', thu) || '-W' || printf('%02d', (CAST(strftime('%j', thu) AS INTEGER)-1)/7+1) AS iso_wk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM w GROUP BY iso_wk ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

WITH RECURSIVE wk(w) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT w+1 FROM wk WHERE w<52),
t AS (
 SELECT CAST((julianday(substr(t.ts_utc,1,10)) - julianday('2024-12-30'))/7 AS INTEGER)+1 AS wk, ta.merchant_id
 FROM txn t JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
 WHERE t.ts_utc >= '2025-01-01' AND t.ts_utc < '2025-12-29'
),
g AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN g.level=2 THEN g.group_id ELSE p.group_id END AS div, t.wk, COUNT(*) c
 FROM t JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=t.merchant_id JOIN dim_merchant_group g ON g.group_id=m.group_id LEFT JOIN dim_merchant_group p ON p.group_id=g.parent_group_id
 GROUP BY 1,2
),
divs AS (SELECT group_id AS div, name FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE level=2),
full AS (
 SELECT d.div, d.name, wk.w AS x, COALESCE(g.c,0) AS y
 FROM divs d CROSS JOIN wk LEFT JOIN g ON g.div=d.div AND g.wk=wk.w
),
s AS (
 SELECT div, name, COUNT(*) n, SUM(x) Sx, SUM(y) Sy, SUM(x*y) Sxy, SUM(x*x) Sxx, SUM(y*y) Syy FROM full GROUP BY div, name
)
SELECT name, div, ROUND((n*Sxy - Sx*Sy)*1.0/(n*Sxx - Sx*Sx),3) AS slope, Sy AS total FROM s ORDER BY slope DESC

WITH x AS (
SELECT s.settled_at, ABS(ROUND(t.amount_minor/CAST(POWER(10,c.exponent) AS REAL) * f.eur_per_unit * 100) - s.settled_eur_minor) AS d
FROM settlement s JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id=s.txn_id JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id=t.currency_id
JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id=t.currency_id AND f.rate_date=substr(s.settled_at,1,10)),
y AS (SELECT settled_at, d, date(substr(settled_at,1,10), '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w',settled_at) AS INTEGER)+6)%7) || ' days', '+3 days') thu FROM x)
SELECT strftime('%Y',thu) || '-W' || printf('%02d', (CAST(strftime('%j',thu) AS INTEGER)-1)/7+1) wk, SUM(d) tot, COUNT(*) n, SUM(d>0) nz FROM y GROUP BY wk ORDER BY tot DESC LIMIT 5
